chunks: Misma‘ ibn ‘Abd al-Malik narrated from Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If a servant were to perform ten hajj pilgrimages, the Hajj of Islam would still remain obligatory upon him when he becomes able to find a way to it.

key_terms.حَجَّةُ الْإِسْلَامِ: the obligatory hajj required by Islam
key_terms.سَبِيلًا: a means or way to perform it

ai.seo_question: Does performing hajj multiple times remove the obligation of Hajj of Islam before one fully qualifies for it?
ai.summary: This hadith states that repeated hajj performed by a slave does not fulfill the obligatory Hajj of Islam before the condition that makes it binding is realized. Once the person attains the required ability, the obligatory hajj remains due upon them.
